name: Gallium nitride
summary: Example of a property that follows from structure rather than from doping: the spontaneous and piezoelectric polarization creates an electron gas at the AlGaN interface without any doping. In terms of the paradigm, an expression that arises from the geometry.

degrees_of_freedom.description: Sum of spontaneous and piezoelectric polarization

inputs.notes: Lattice mismatch to the AlGaN barrier; built into the heterostructure

validity.condition: P_pz = 2*eps*(e31 - e33*C13/C33); sign and magnitude corrected relative to v0.1, where e33 was incorrectly coupled directly to the biaxial strain
n = sigma_pol / q; polarization difference at the AlGaN/GaN interface

couplings.source: Ambacher et al., J. Appl. Phys. 85, 3222 (1999)
couplings.notes: Key point: carrier density around 1e17 m^-2 without doping. Structure replaces chemistry.

validity.condition: scale = q*mu with mu = 0.15 m^2/(V*s) at 300 K

gaps: The polarization is fixed in the finished heterostructure; biaxial_strain is not a free actuation route during operation, but a design parameter.
Strictly speaking this entry describes a heterostructure, not the pure material. It points to the need for a dedicated entry type for interfaces.

The spontaneous polarization of -0.029 C/m^2 comes from Bernardini 1997 and was revised in 2001 to -0.034 C/m^2. The older value is retained because the remaining constants come from the same work; on an update the whole set has to be exchanged.
sources: Bernardini, Fiorentini & Vanderbilt, Phys. Rev. B 56, R10024 (1997)
Ambacher et al., J. Appl. Phys. 85, 3222 (1999)
Bernardini & Fiorentini, Phys. Rev. B 64, 085207 (2001), doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.64.085207 (revised spontaneous polarization)
